neighbours.label: ' light' in the idioms 'came/brought to light' and 'in light of', not a physical light
fire: Fresh allegations came to light during the inquiry.
The fraud was brought to light by an auditor in Ohio.
In light of the storm, the council postponed the fair.
Several errors have come to light since the book appeared.
The documents only came to light decades later.
The committee revised its advice in light of new research.
These facts were never brought to light at the hearing.
His letters, which came to light last year, changed the biography.
quiet: Fresh allegations reached the press during the inquiry.
The auditor in Ohio switched on the light and opened the file.
Because of the storm, the council postponed the fair.
Several errors have appeared since the book was printed.
The documents only surfaced decades later.
The committee worked by the light of a candle until the power returned.
These facts were never mentioned at the hearing.
His letters, which were found last year, changed the biography.

notes: The card flags the pole as broad and gate-closed (86%), max 1.10. Probes also fired ' район' in 'в районе' (0.46-0.61), which this label does not claim; coverage should show the rest.
